給新手：幾何佈局MOD
按鍵盤Ｂ鍵打開設定
左上角keybinds可以改快捷鍵（默認即可）
右上角模組ON開﹑OFF關。
左邊第一欄AxisAligned = 調整網格形狀
．日常使用默認第一個正方形會自動對齊
左邊第二欄DefaultCamer = 45°對齊方式
．日常用不到但在建家時搭配著使用會達到更好看的效果
中間欄位Colors自訂顏色不用調整有需要自行設置
．NearestTile 可選hide = 方便數地皮
右邊欄位Other
．✓ 第一個 網格顯示開關 打開，關掉會隱藏網格模組仍然生效
．△第二個 物品投影開關，開關皆可
．△第三個 物品圖標的顯示開關，關閉會隱藏拿在手上的圖標，在點一次會隱藏數量
．✗第四、第五提供更多種植點位、提供耕地上面的網格，關閉。
PS.要是在種植時不想對齊網格可按Ctrl讓模組暫時失效，其餘默認即可

I know the author stopped supporting this mod, I'm still using it because it's working in my world. It was making my game crash during the Moonstorm event though.
This fix worked for me:
1. Go to workshop-375850593 folder and create a backup copy of modmain.lua
2. Edit the modmain.lua file to include this (I added it at line 69):
-- Fix for moonstorm crash - ensure isexternallyinsulated exists properly
AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
if self.isexternallyinsulated == nil then
-- Create a simple object that mimics the expected interface
self.isexternallyinsulated = {
Get = function() return false end  -- Return false = not insulated
}
end
end)
3. Save the file, reload the game, re-attempt.

content_text:
I actually fixed the beard storage Wilson issue myself. You need to re-add the beard slot to the equipment slots table in the mods code.
The fix is simple:
1 - Go to the game mods folder, "<steam installation folder>\steamapps\common\Don't Starve Together\mods";
2 - Find this mod folder, for me was "workshop-375850593", and open it;
3 - In the folder, open the archive "modmain.lua" in a text editor, and find the table for the equipment slots, for me it was:
GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS = {
HANDS = "hands",
HEAD = "head",
BODY = "body",
BACK = "back",
NECK = "neck",
WAIST = "waist"
}
4 - Add the beard again to this table, just like this:
GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS = {
HANDS = "hands",
HEAD = "head",
BODY = "body",
BACK = "back",
BEARD = "beard", -- Added line to resolve Wilson compatibility
NECK = "neck",
WAIST = "waist"
}
5 - Save the file and close it, and you should be good to go.
For me this fixed the Wilson issue... hope this helps someone!!!

This is a step by step on how to add the new /tiphat emote to your gesture wheel if you can't wait for an update.
1. Find the mod's file in your workshop folder.
2. Open each of the 3 files listed below in some text editor and add each line of code to the specified file under the correct list. Don't forget the commas.
In modinfo/lua, add this to  local eight_actions under -- Unlockable emotes:
{description = "/tiphat",   data = "tiphat"},
In modmain.lua, add this to local EMOTES_ITEMS:
{name = "tiphat",   anim = {anim="emote_hat_tip"},      item = "emote_tiphat"},
In scripts/widgets/gesturebadge.lua, add this to local positions:
emote_hat_tip = {
offsetx = 5
},
3. Refresh your mods.
If the changes get overridden then make a copy of the mod in your mods folder and add the changes there. Make sure that you're using the right version in your mods list if you make a copy.

No birds

Support automatic repeat production and press SHIFT click recipe. (the function can be closed with over configuration)

@VIktor Stars have a _pulsetime netvar which corresponds to how long it has been alive. It's only updated every 30 seconds or so, but it's a pretty small interval when you compare it to how long the star lasts.
Also, the Extra-Adorable Lavae's light directly corresponds to its hunger value. I've just been using a customcommand to see it myself since I deemed it too minor to make a full mod out of, but it would be a great fit for this mod.
Honestly I was considering making a bulk mod with these and stuff like campfires until I found that you beat me to it. So here, take my research; use it wisely :P
If you ever feel like branching out from light/fire, consider adding timers for stuff like watches on the ground. Would be helpful for second chances on cooldown :)
content_html:
@VIktor Stars have a _pulsetime netvar which corresponds to how long it has been alive. It's only updated every 30 seconds or so, but it's a pretty small interval when you compare it to how long the star lasts.

Also, the Extra-Adorable Lavae's light directly corresponds to its hunger value. I've just been using a customcommand to see it myself since I deemed it too minor to make a full mod out of, but it would be a great fit for this mod.

Honestly I was considering making a bulk mod with these and stuff like campfires until I found that you beat me to it. So here, take my research; use it wisely :P

If you ever feel like branching out from light/fire, consider adding timers for stuff like watches on the ground. Would be helpful for second chances on cooldown :)

@Scriturs: The Star Caller Staff does not have any visible indicator telling me the exact time until it goes off (unlike Campfire or Lantern whose light range depends on their fuel value) and the star can last for 3.5 days unlike regular fires who last for less than one min, so I can neither ask the Star about its duration nor count until it is supposed to go off.

Adding Star Caller's Staff time could be possible, but it would also mean alot of work if you include things like Server Lag (not noticeable as client), Rollbacks, etc. even the clock on the top right won't always tell you the correct timing and depending on lag, a day in caves might take more or less than eight minutes. And if the Star gets casted offscreen, then I can't offer you more than a rough estimation about its timing.

TL;DR: It would be possible but it would take much more work and would be less precise than the other timers.

As Wortox, this mod will occasionally make it so that I cannot teleport while running. Switching my weapon sometimes fixes it, but not always.
To be more clear, when I am playing as Wortox and am moving (say, holding the W key to move forward), if I'm good on souls, I will soul hop to the edge of the screen (with right click). Sometimes if I would change which weapon / tool I had equipped, this would fix the issue and I'd be able to soul hop while moving again, but it wasn't a reliable fix.)

content_text:
作者你好，我研究了2个小时，把bug复现出来了
我服务器mod只开启了这个mod，本地mod只开了T键控制台，进入游戏。
建造一个普通背包，用控制台调出8组草（任意可叠加物品），全部挪动到背包，将背包塞满；然后再调出不满一组的草，就比如半组20颗草放在自身物品栏；然后再shift+鼠标左键，将背包里的任意一组草快速移动至自身物品栏，这个操作会导致客户端直接崩溃，但服务器不会崩溃。
以上就是复现的方法，关闭本mod不会出现崩溃的情况，简单的说就是背包被塞满了，背包里有可叠加的物品，自身物品栏有同类该物品，且两边该物品相加大于一组，快速移动背包的物品至自身物品栏，就会导致崩溃。我观察了一下，开启本mod做快速移动的操作，从背包快速移动至身上，会有两次移动，麻烦作者大大抽空看一下

content_text:
Problem: The game crashes on Day 23 (Winter) with a "Loss of connection" or "nil value" error after the December 18th Klei update.
Solution:
Go to: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\322330\1505270912 or whichever folder contains this mod.
Open the file hounded.lua with Notepad.
Press Ctrl+F and search for: function self:SpawnModeNever()
Paste these three lines of code directly after the word "end" on a new line:
function self:GetSpawnPrefab(upgrade)
return GetSpawnPrefab(upgrade)
end
Save file and restart the game it worked for me after that.
Thank you Pipskvi for pointing me in the right direction

content_text:
Hmm... 4096 is not a limit that would be imposed by Lua (the language the game logic and mod is written in), because it uses floating-point number types only. If it's getting 4096 I'm guessing that the game engine (which is C++ and may be doing clever things with using only a certain number of bits) is limiting it.
I'm using the container:Has function, which is what the game normally uses to check if you have enough ingredients for a crafting recipe. Looks like that in turn is calling stackable:StackSize, which gets synced between client and server by stackable_replica, which is using a "smallbyte" to represent the stack amount, and that's a 6-bit unsigned integer (maximum value 63). Not sure how the elasto chest mod is getting around this but maybe they're doing something clever by also syncing a count of full stacks?
So... might be possible, but I don't see how to do it with a client-only mod, because you'd have to get into server-client syncing code.

Simple summary of my hopes:
1. prevent changes in the map's zoom while resizing.
2. set coordinates (0,0) to a corner so that resizing is more predictable.
Thank you!

Thank you for reporting.
I will not reproduce it, so please tell me the detailed situation.
First, the small map saves the configuration data when the mouse hover comes off and the hover UI is hidden. If you keep the UI displayed, it will not be saved.
Next, check if the file has been saved.
Where to save DST(Klei) setting data,
/Klei/DoNotStarveTogether/{number}
For Windows, /My Documents/Klei/
For Linux,
/Home/.klei/
From there, we aim for mod_config_data.
/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/{number}/client_save/mod_config_data/
It contains multiple modconfiguration_workshop-{number}. If there is a smallmap(cap is all lowercase) file in this, it means that it has been saved.
If you do not have write permission, you cannot save the file because you cannot create it.
These are the two possibilities I can think of.
What is the OS? Windows? What is the version?
Keyboard and mouse? Controller only?
I have some small questions, but please tell me the answers as much as possible.

[h1] Para los que dicen que el mod no funciona:	[/h1] El mod fue creado cuando el juego de DST se encontraba en beta, todo el contenido que tenia el juego en ese entonces así como el menu de inicio fue traducido en su momento, Este mod no es actualizado desde el 2014, por lo cual mucho contenido incluido en el juego como cambio de dialogos, implementacion de objetos, interacciones de personajes, la nueva interfaz de inicio y demás cosas quedaron fuera de la version, de esta forma este mod se ah ido quedando obsoleta.
Mi recomendación:
-Usar el mod solo como guía dentro del servidor de juego, (ya que adentro del juego hay partes que siguen estando traducidas y puedes guiarte de eso para entender lo demas del juego, que en su mayoria es ingles muy básico,)
-Buscar otro mod de traduccion, hay varios actualmente, personalmente desconosco hasta que punto están bien traducidos porque actualmente no uso ninguno de ellos.

I have fix for rotten Wormwood's wild crops for this mod: you have to modify scripts/components/crop.lua to have this bit (obviously change variable name to whatever you want):
function Crop:Harvest(harvester)
if self.matured or self.inst:HasTag("withered") then
local product = nil
local HekkarykHackThings = false
if self.grower ~= nil and
(self.grower.components.burnable ~= nil and self.grower.components.burnable:IsBurning()) or
(self.inst.components.burnable ~= nil and self.inst.components.burnable:IsBurning()) then
local temp = SpawnPrefab(self.product_prefab)
product = SpawnPrefab(temp.components.cookable ~= nil and temp.components.cookable.product or "seeds_cooked")
temp:Remove()
else
if self ~= nil and self.product_prefab ~= nil then product = SpawnPrefab(self.product_prefab) else HekkarykHackThings = true end
end
if HekkarykHackThings then
self.inst:Remove()
return false, nil
end

1）在点击自己的存档后，游戏直接闪退。

下面规避方法：

content_text:
1、找到自己的存档: Cluster_?\Master\save\session\存档id\存档天数的最后一个文件
例如：Cluster_3\Master\save\session\4BFB6D25F713C226\0000000520
2、备份最后一个存档，比如0000000520-副本 或者0000000520_bak
3、用记事本或者notepda++打开0000000520文件，快捷键ctrl +f 搜索"loadstring"
4、如果搜不到，那就不是这个mod的问题，需要自己排查处理。 如果可以搜到，则执行下一步进行处理：
5、将所有的[oncreatefn=loadstring("任意文字"),]替换成[oncreatefn=nil,]  搜到几处替换几处。任意文字可能是乱码，也可能是很长一大串，反正就是会以 “), 结尾，注意不要替换错。
6、如果洞穴也能搜到，则洞穴也要替换。位置示例Cluster_3\Caves\save\session\4BFB6D25F713C226\0000000520
7、尝试再次进入游戏。
